changes.finding: generic provider 502 mapping could finalize ambiguous writes
changes.disposition: Scoped 502 unavailability/contract-invalid to ticket lookup or proved no-write failures; possible-receipt execute responses are 202 ExecutionIndeterminate.
Mapped unavailable/timeout/unknown/malformed observation to 202 ReconciliationIndeterminate and kept not-found as a distinct 202 projection.
Only provider found(succeeded) or found(failed(closed_code)) may finalize; no ambiguous observation becomes failed.
